pages.title: Select an Image
pages.text: Use Gallery to browse your available images.$(br2)Search by name, then select an image to display it. The Displayed badge marks the current image.

pages.title: Select an Image
pages.text: Gallery Refresh reloads the available image list.

pages.title: Remove an Image
pages.text: Remove asks for confirmation before deleting an image.$(br2)Deletion affects displays using that image.

pages.title: Remove an Image
pages.text: Being allowed to control a screen does not let you delete or browse another player's private images.
